preconditions.description: The number of volumes n is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: any(output.count(x) == 1 for x in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each number from 1 to n appears exactly once in the output.

postconditions.expression: any(sum(1 for i in range(n) if j % i == 0 and output[j] % i == 0) < min_divisors for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output minimizes the number of divisors for any i such that for at least one j (1 ≤ j ≤ n) both: j mod i = 0 and at the same time p(j) mod i = 0.
